moments.text: kemal: Kemal comes to your table. “Hatice, speak to me straight. People have stopped coming to my shop. I came to ask what you told them.” The neighbours take their cups away. The benches will stay empty for a day.

osman: Osman comes to your table. “I have carried heavier things than a little truth. We share a house, Hatice. You could have spoken to me at home.” The neighbours take their cups away. The benches will stay empty for a day.

zehra: Zehra comes to your table. “I heard you from the grocer’s counter. I spoke to Meryem about your account of me. You should have asked me first.” The neighbours take their cups away. The benches will stay empty for a day.
